messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: high-priority alert for customer CobaltFinance (dedicated pool). Potential unredacted PII surfaced in tenant logs during a support search. Runbook: vpc-log-pii. Pager: lee (SRE) assigned. https://pager.example/incident/1767501234

lee (SRE): ack — I'm taking lead. Triage kickoff: isolate tenant exports, confirm S3/forwarders, and get CS + Security + Legal in thread.

maria (CS): Customer says their audit team found full-text results with SSN-like patterns in logs. They're asking us to preserve original logs for legal review and want retention extended. They're worried about data disclosure.

lee (SRE): understoood. Immediate actions I'm planning: 1) disable any external log export for the tenant, 2) set service log level -> WARN for tenant to limit noise, 3) freeze retention for tenant logs to prevent auto-deletion. Need Legal sign-off if we are going to preserve raw (unredacted) logs.

raj (Security): do NOT re-enable redaction bypass in prod indiscriminately. Suggest creating an encrypted escrow copy of the raw logs in a customer-scoped bucket, KMS-encrypted, with tightly-scoped IAM and documented chain-of-custody. That lets Legal/CS review without exposing raw logs in our normal pipelines.

jordan (Legal): we can authorize a temporary legal hold/escrow, but two conditions: (a) explicit customer written approval or legal hold request, (b) access controls and audit trail documented. Limit retention to the minimum necessary and delete after retention period unless court order. We'll need to log who accessed the escrow and why.

ops (Eng Runtime): OK — we have a tool for this: `redwood-log-escrow`. Example invocation to create an encrypted raw copy for tenant `cobalt-finance`:
```
# create escrow archive (run as oncall with ops role)
redwood-log-escrow --tenant cobalt-finance --from 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z --to 2026-03-15T12:00:00Z \
  --kms-key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 --bucket redwood-escrow-cobalt --retain-raw true
```
Flags: `--retain-raw true` disables redaction on the copied archive only. The runtime will not touch production redaction settings. The job will write an audit file with SHA256 checksums and requester metadata.

lee (SRE): running the escrow job now. `job-id: escrow-1767501234-01`. Patch output: `started copy -> 2.1GB, 4 shards`. Turning off external forwarders for tenant: done. Setting retention freeze: done.

incident-bot: audit-log: escrow job `escrow-1767501234-01` created by lee (SRE) at 2026-03-05T15:12:10Z. Access token TTL 24h, recorded to audit index.

privacy-bot: PII-scan triggered on existing logs. Note: since we created an encrypted escrow with `--retain-raw true`, the normal prod redaction pipeline was NOT changed. Any future access to escrow requires `escrow-read` ACL and Legal approval.

maria (CS): Customer asked for a live call. I'm scheduling a bridge now. Also collecting their written hold request (email). Once we have that, can Legal approve access?

jordan (Legal): agree — need written hold + CS confirmation. After that Legal will sign the internal access form. Please create a JIRA and include: chain-of-custody, exact S3 prefix, KMS key ID, TTL, and requester. Use template: `INC-ESCROW-REQUEST`.

lee (SRE): JIRA created: RDW-2859 — includes job id, S3 prefix `s3://redwood-escrow-cobalt/escrow-1767501234-01/`, KMS `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01`. Monitoring copy progress: 40% -> 80% -> completed.

ops (Eng Runtime): escrow job completed. Verification: checksums match. Audit file: `s3://redwood-escrow-cobalt/escrow-1767501234-01/audit.json` (access controlled). Please note: we did not modify the tenant's running redaction rules anywhere in prod.

raj (Security): logged the event in security tracker and flagged for follow-up: rotate any short-lived tokens that touched the archive. Recommend a scoped review of who has `escrow-read` role.

maria (CS): customer confirmed via email (attached) and on call. They requested 30-day hold pending internal review. They've accepted escrow to redwood KMS.

jordan (Legal): documented approval received. Legal approves limited access to escrow for review by customer's counsel + Redwood Legal. Access granted to `legal@redwood` and `maria@redwood` once CS uploads signed hold. All access must be via the `escrow-read` role and recorded.

lee (SRE): summary for incident record: impact: potential exposure surfaced internally during customer search; mitigation: external exports disabled, retention frozen, raw escrow created and encrypted, redaction left in place for prod; status: monitoring, awaiting Legal/CS handoff. Closing active pager.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: pager closed by lee (SRE). Next: handoff to CS + Legal for customer review. If any new evidence is found, re-open with `high` severity. :white_check_mark:
